cause.description: The 4,328-entry glyph dictionary is a left-deep chain of 4,327 comma operators, bundled through src/detect.ts and src/pdf-preflight.ts. No diagram lot source is in the published closure. Ordinary optimized local Node runs passed; disabling JIT deterministically reproduces the CI visit/forEachChildInBinaryExpression stack overflow on the unchanged base bundle.

fix.description: Build-only conversion of the upstream numeric glyph dictionary to JSON.parse plus Object.assign. Runtime data, property descriptors and insertion order are checked against the complete original factory. No acceptance/scanner modification or stack-size increase.

reproduction.baseError: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded (visit / forEachChildInBinaryExpression)
reproduction.fixedCommand: node --jitless --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import {staticEdges} from './scripts/substrate-tarball-acceptance.mjs'; staticEdges(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8'));" dist/index.js

validation.setup: npm 11.21.1; root and engram-memory lockfiles installed with --ignore-scripts; existing fs-ext 2.1.1 and better-sqlite3 12.11.1 binaries copied using Node fs after checking the Node ABI. No Python execution.
